page.overview:
Who is Archibold von Lilahalle?

Graf Archibold von Lilahalle is the High Lord of the Chair circa 2512 IC on the Reikland Council. He was given this influential position by Emperor Luitpold, after he saved that man's life during an assassination attempt. An injury sustained in the event confined him to a steam-driven wheelchair. However, it would be unwise to point out the irony of his title.
